subtitle: Out Manila · Philippine Airlines
overview: A pilgrimage-themed tour that pairs Beijing’s landmarks (Forbidden City, Great Wall, Summer Palace) with its historic churches, then takes the high-speed train to Shanghai for the Xujiahui Cathedral and the Shrine of Our Lady of Lourdes. You stay in 5-star Beijing and 4-star Shanghai hotels with daily breakfast.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 1–7 2026 to Dec 6–12 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Wudaoying Hutong: A trendy Beijing hutong lane with small cafes and boutiques, visited on the evening of arrival.
placeDesc.Shichahai: A lakeside area in central Beijing, popular for walks among old hutongs.
placeDesc.Xuanwumen Church: A Catholic church in central Beijing, also called the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: One of the largest public squares in the world, in the heart of Beijing.
placeDesc.Palace Museum: The Forbidden City, the former imperial palace of Ming and Qing emperors in Beijing.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Street: A famous Beijing shopping and snack street.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-known section of the Great Wall north of Beijing, set in a mountain pass.
placeDesc.Summer Palace: A former imperial garden with a lake and pavilions in Beijing; boat tour not included.
placeDesc.St. Michael’s Church: A Catholic church in Beijing's Dongjiaominxiang area, visited before the train to Shanghai.
placeDesc.Dongjiaominxiang: The longest hutong in Beijing, a historic lane lined with old buildings.
placeDesc.Xujiahui Cathedral: Saint Ignatius Cathedral in Shanghai's Xujiahui district, a landmark Catholic church.
placeDesc.Zi-Ka-Wei Library: The Bibliotheca Zi-Ka-Wei, a historic library next to Xujiahui Cathedral in Shanghai.
placeDesc.City God Temple: The Chenghuang temple area in old Shanghai, with traditional buildings and shops.
placeDesc.Shrine of Our Lady of Lourdes: A Catholic shrine in Shanghai visited on the final morning before the airport transfer.
